opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with the Trust contributing salary costs and up to £6,000 per annum in research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas; applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented area of research, lasting 3 to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education (and on a trial basis UK-based independent research institutes/organisations).
opportunities.summary: For researchers to undertake an innovative and original research project of up to 5 years, assessed via a two-stage process (outline and detailed applications). The outline stage is paused; detailed applications are open until 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers in any discipline holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research, to complete a piece of research over 3 to 24 months. Application materials available on the page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post, living in the UK for a minimum of 26 weeks a year, with an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, tenable for 3 to 24 months. Application materials available on the page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early career scholars at UK universities who have yet to lead a team, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4 to 5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
